supporting_observations.claim: At 13:47:35 UTC, a connection from FILE-BLU-01 (10.54.20.20) to the explicit proxy (10.54.20.30:8080) recorded 640,000,395 bytes sent and 39,204 bytes received.

The transfer's size and source are consistent with the inventory's description of Cloudkeep backups, which upload several hundred MB from FILE-BLU-01, but the available connection record does not identify Cloudkeep or another destination.
A nearby connection from FILE-BLU-01 to the proxy recorded substantially more received than sent bytes; it does not establish the destination or explain the large upload.

known_telemetry_limitations: The large-transfer record identifies only the proxy endpoint and byte counts; it contains no URL, destination hostname, proxy request details, or process identity.
The evidence does not show which FILE-BLU-01 process generated the transfer or what data was transmitted.
claims_not_established: Whether the transfer was made by the approved Cloudkeep backup agent to cloudkeep-backup.com.
Whether the transferred data was authorized backup data or sensitive data sent to an unapproved destination.
Whether the activity was malicious or benign.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve PROXY-BLU-01 logs for the large transfer, including CONNECT target, URL or host, authenticated user, and request/response byte counts.
Collect FILE-BLU-01 process-to-network telemetry and Cloudkeep agent logs around 13:47 UTC, including upload job status and destination.
Compare the transferred data or backup job with approved backup scope and expected activity.
unrelated_findings: WS-RMOSS-01 user ruth.moss launched mstsc.exe to FILE-BLU-01 and established an RDP connection; remote administration is documented as restricted to WS-KITO-01. Track separately; this does not establish who initiated or caused the alerted transfer. (T200-00273, T200-00274, T200-00277, T200-00280, T200-00281)
